chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
The ghusl (ritual bath) for janabah and menstruation is one and the same.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: janabah, a state of major ritual impurity
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation, the menstrual state requiring ghusl after it ends
key_terms.غُسْلُ: ghusl (ritual bath), the prescribed washing for ritual purification
key_terms.وَاحِدٌ: one and the same, indicating identical ruling or form

ai.seo_question: Is the ghusl for janabah the same as the ghusl for menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the ghusl for janabah and the ghusl for menstruation are the same in form. It conveys a concise fiqh ruling concerning ritual purification.
